text:
rachael: quick check on SI co-sell rules for CloudX integration. we need a deterministic handoff so partners don't get ghosted.
mike: agree. volume expected ~8-15/wk from marketplace and ChannelPartner referrals.
sanjay: proposal: marketplace leads auto-get tag `si:cloudx`. then ops routes to SDR queue within 2h. SDR must set `owner:ae/` or `owner:partner/` within 24h.
tess: +1 but add fallback: if owner not set in 24h, auto-notify partner champion and partner gets temp ownership for 48h. keeps momentum.
partner-bot: CloudX listing active — attribution_key=cloudx_mp_2025 applies to marketplace leads.
rachael: make credit rule explicit: partner keeps co-sell credit if they hosted initial demo; if AE joins and converts within 30 days, credit is split per contract.
mike: operational items: add claim tags to intake schema (`claim:si/cloudx`, `owner:sdr/<email>`, `owner:ae/<email>`, `origin:marketplace/<key>`).
sanjay: logging: emit `lead.claim.v1` webhook on every change. sample event saved as string in audit log.
tess: pilot window 6/1-6/14. let's monitor SLA (2h routing, 24h ownership set). sanjay will add metrics dashboard.
rachael: assign actions: mike -> PR schema + sample intake form, sanjay -> webhook + dashboard, tess -> draft partner-facing one-pager, i'll coordinate partner comms.
mike: will PR today.
sanjay: dashboard ETA Tue.
tess: drafting note now.
rachael: thanks all — will post final doc in partnerships/handbook and ping partners. :rocket:
